title.romaji: Inou-Battle wa Nichijou-kei no Naka de
title.native: 異能バトルは日常系のなかで

synonyms: พลังป่วนก๊วนเหนือธรรมชาติ
description:
The five members of the literature club awakened with extraordinary powers half a year ago. Although the members expected to be thrown into a world of super-powered battles at their school, their normal daily routine continued. No secret organizations bent on world destruction, no super-powered wars, no brave heroes or demon kings. However, the members still look forward to the possibilities of adventure, and continued to believe that with each day, they were getting ever closer to those days of fantasy. Their days of romantic comedy and battles with extraordinary powers begin!

(Source: Anime News Network)

node.description: Mako is a second year student at Honnouji Academy. She is an uber air-head, so her unbelievable actions never cease to shock and awe the people around her. She strongly believes that she and [Ryuko](https://anilist.co/character/83797) are best of friends even though they have just met.

Hatoko Kushikawa is one of the main characters of Ino Battle wa Nichijo-kei no Naka de. She is also a part of the Literature Club.

She is a polite air-headed girl who often takes Jurai's chunibyo antics seriously. Her power is "Over Element," which gives her the ability to manipulate five main elements of the natural world: earth, water, fire, wind, and light.

She is also Jurai's childhood friend and next door neighbor, who sometimes drops by to his house to cook for him and his big sister, since both of them admit to being bad at cooking. She has a tendency to be jealous towards Jurai when she sees him with Tomoyo, though she keeps quiet about it.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Tomoyo Kanzaki is one of the main characters of Ino Battle wa Nichijou-kei no Naka de. She has the superpower to manipulate time, "Closed Clock," and she is also part of the Literature Club.

A red-haired girl who is constantly bemused by Jurai's antics. Her power allow her to speed up, slow down, or stop time, though she cannot rewind it.

She is a shy elementary school girl, she was accepted as an unofficial member of the Literature Club mainly because she is the club advisers's relative. Her special powers allows her to create anything out of thin air, she can also create portals, dimensions and she can also manipulate any materials down to its sub atomic level. 

Just like the rest of the girls in her club, she too has feelings for Andou.

(Source: Zinc View)

Jurai is the main protagonist of Ino Battle wa Nichijo-kei no Naka de. He is also part of the school Literature Club on his right hand he has a superpower called, "Dark and Dark."

Jurai is a goofy boy. Due to his Chunin Syndrome, he often falls into a world of his own, causing annoyance to those around him. Because of this he has developed a very care free personality that can often accept other peoples' faults without much trouble. When he gained his superpower, he was excited, saying that even though it didn't do much, he still loved it all the same, because every guy wants one.

(Source: Inou-Battle wa Nichijou-kei no Naka de Wikia)

She is a senior student and the president of the Literature Club. She is normally seen reading books, and there are hints that she has feelings for Andou. Her power is "Root of Origins" in which anyone she touches returns to his or her original state, although the exact nature of this remains vague. She a very refine girl, whose other hobbies, besides reading, includes ikebana, origami, and martial arts.

For some reason, she dislikes being called "cute."

(Source: Zince-View, edited)

She is the school's student council president, who always gets to reprimand the Literature Club for being noisy mainly due to Andou's antics. She somehow acquires the ability to steal someone else's special powers and use it as well, where she can only do when that particular individual with special powers activates it first. She briefly falls in love with Andou because she mistaken the letter that she receives from him as a love letter wherein one particular caption he misused the kanji symbols that reads "grateful lover" instead of "great robber," referring to her special powers, which is what Andou intended to be.

In spite of the painful misunderstanding she becomes friends with Andou.

(Source: Wikipedia)

Chifuyu's closest friend and classmate. Madoka cares for Chifuyu so much that she is usually seen keeping her in check by fixing her uniform, brushing her, walking her to school, etc. Chifuyu refers to her as "Cookie."

He is Tomoyo's half brother. Though he is a NEET (Not in Education Employment or Training), he spends most of his time engage in "Fairy Wars" where he fights with other people with special abilities or "power users" like himself. His special ability is the "Pinpoint Abyss" where he opens up worm holes that sucks his opponents in, to which they get transported to their previous location prior to the encounter without any memories of what just happen. He is also like Jurai who has some degree of chunni delusions except that his delusion were at bit real. Though a lone-wolf, he can sometimes be in the company of other people who are also "power users" and were also engage in fairy wars.

Prior to being a "power user" he used to attend college and even had a job.

He dislikes being called by his real name and prefers to be called "Kiryuu Heldkaiser Luci-First." 

(Source: Animefreak, edited)

She is a fairy who is with the War Management Committee. Basically, she functions as a consultant to Hajime's clique with all matters concerning the "fairy war." Though small in size, she can be quite a handful when arguing with some members of the clique, most especially Hajime.

(Source: Anime plus, edited)
Maiya is Sayumi's little sister. She is quite different from older sister in which Sayumi comments her as "wild and ill-mannered." She thinks her sister and Andou are possibly dating.
She is one of the members of Hajime's clique who is also a "power user," her ability is the "Eternal Wink" which suggest that her ability is to put people to sleep.

He is Andou's school mate and an otaku. However, he and Andou don't get along. He is also a member a Kiryu's group.

He is very observant and manipulative, it is is suggested that he is also a power user whose ability is to read minds.

The Literature Club's adviser and Chifuyu's aunt. Because she is very busy with school work, she left Chifuyu with the Literature Club to play. She is also the one who gave Chifuyu her doll. Satomi is also seen sleeping occasionally.
